newsitem.title: USA: General Cigar's IPO price range raised.
newsitem.headline: General Cigar's IPO price range raised.

text.p: The estimated price range on General Cigar Corp's six million Class A share initial public offering has been raised to $16 to $18 per share from $14 to $16 per share, said underwriter Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities.

All of the shares of General Cigar's Class B common stock are owned by parent company Culbro Corp. Each class B share entitles the holder to ten votes, whereas each Class A share will give the holder one vote, according to the company's filing.

General Cigar, according to its prospectus, is the largest manufacturer and marketer in the United States of brand-name premium cigars. Its line of products include two top selling brands, Macanudo and Partagas.
The deal is set to make its debut on the big board later this week under the proposed stock symbol "MPP".
